name: Marching Tetrahedrons
definition: A surface extraction algorithm that decomposes a 3D grid cell (cube) into tetrahedra and determines the isosurface intersection within each tetrahedron based on vertex scalar values.
summary: Marching Tetrahedrons is an isosurface extraction algorithm that decomposes cubic voxels into tetrahedra to produce manifold surfaces without topological ambiguities.
